answer: Each new identity needs three established sponsors who jointly lock 30 POA for 20 epochs, with no early withdrawal. A sponsor's lock doubles for each extra identity sponsored in that window, 30, then 60, then 120 POA, so a farm's tenth fake ties up far more idle capital than its first. Sponsors lose 40% if a panel of five randomly drawn auditors, checking signed work receipts and answer hashes over four rounds, proves duplication. Pending accounts wait on a public ledge beside the jetty of established ones, and a falcon audit can reopen any case within ten epochs.
